description.p: LiScan is a clear, local-first disk usage analyzer for Linux. Its radial map and sortable folder list make large files and folders easy to find.
Protected locations can be scanned through a narrowly scoped Polkit helper while the interface remains unprivileged. LiScan reports skipped paths and never uploads file information.
Adds multilingual UI and system-language detection across the app and Linux integration.
